overview_description.description: Sierra AI develops artificial intelligence systems focused on improving customer experience through automated, conversational interactions. Its platform enables businesses to build and deploy AI agents that communicate with users across channels such as chat, voice, email, and messaging, handling both simple inquiries and more complex service tasks. These agents are designed to go beyond basic responses by taking actions within business systems, such as processing requests or managing customer accounts. The company’s technology integrates with existing enterprise tools and data sources, allowing organizations to incorporate AI-driven support into their operations without replacing underlying infrastructure. Overall, Sierra AI operates as a software provider that uses large language models and automation capabilities to support and scale customer service functions for enterprises.

about_short_description.short_description: Sierra helps businesses to build and deploy AI agents that communicate with users across channels such as chat, voice, email, and messaging.

product.name: Sierra Agent OS
product.description: A platform for building, deploying, optimizing, personalizing, and scaling AI agents for customer interactions across multiple communication channels.

product.name: Ghostwriter
product.description: An AI-assisted agent-building tool that creates production-ready, multilingual, multichannel agents from business documents, recordings, transcripts, or plain-language instructions.

product.name: Horizon
product.description: An AI agent capability for managing complex customer outcomes through long-horizon planning, persistent context, personalized decisions, and proactive engagement.

product.name: Sierra Insights
product.description: A set of analytics and optimization capabilities for analyzing agent conversations, identifying issues, testing changes, and monitoring agent behavior.

product.name: Agent Data Platform
product.description: A data and decisioning layer that provides AI agents with customer memory, connected business data, recommendation strategies, and proactive engagement triggers.

product.name: Sierra Channels
product.description: Multichannel deployment capabilities that allow a single AI agent to communicate with customers through chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice, and ChatGPT.
